create_hanabi_game: create a HanabiGame with custom parameters like players, colors, ranks, and tokens
create_hanabi_state: create a new HanabiState from a HanabiGame to start a fresh game
get_legal_moves: get the list of legal moves for the currently acting player in a HanabiState
apply_move_to_state: apply a HanabiMove to advance the game state to the next turn
encode_observation: encode a HanabiObservation into a canonical bit-string representation
